promotion_rule: Only an exact exposed-W05 semantic MATCH within the frozen envelope may authorize byte-freezing the R25 candidate for post-discovery controls on already exposed R19-W06..W08. Fresh unseen testing requires a later new freeze and selector.
claim_ceiling: R25 tests one exposed world and one structurally preregistered existential-elimination schedule. It cannot establish polynomial scaling, efficient cutset enumeration, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
